purpose: v11 exact selection with compact adaptive GPU staging

runs.note: Native learned ceil/threshold ties UNION recent-20; current input KV always computed locally. Prefill is Full. V11 staging starts at ceil(max_length * ratio) + recent, grows without truncating ties. Async carries unpublished newest history from GPU. Timing includes selection, host packing and real copies; GPU event intervals under concurrency are elapsed stream intervals, not isolated service time.
